summary.text: On Tarkir, Sarkhan Vol travels back in time more than a thousand years to save the dying spirit dragon Ugin, wrapping him in a hedron cocoon, and returns to a changed present where dragons rule the skies and the five clans.

In this new Tarkir, the old khans are gone and the word khan is forbidden under the dragonlords, and Sarkhan finds that nobody he knew remembers him; Narset, once a student of the dragon Ojutai, never died and instead became a planeswalker.
Sorin Markov destroys the cocoon and frees Ugin, who tells him the Eldrazi have escaped, and Sarkhan and Narset come to find that they are content to stay on Tarkir for now.
